name: Avatar
summary: Picture of a person: photo, initials or an icon, with an optional online status.
use: Next to names in lists, tables, headers and comments.
avoid: As the only way to show a person, with no name nearby.
anatomy: Circle with a photo, initials or an icon.
figmaProps: Photo: put an image fill on the circle.
reactProps: Falls back to initials if the photo does not load.
Status for screen readers. Defaults in DEFAULT_AVATAR_LABELS.
behaviour: If a photo does not load, the avatar shows initials.
a11y: role="img" with the name as its label. If the name is already next to it, the avatar is decorative.
do: Use the same size within one list.
dont: Show an important status with color only: also put it in text.
